overview: The biggest stories are Elon Musk's escalating SpaceX valuation claims and a run of Starlink regulatory wins in Brazil and Venezuela. AI news centered on Anthropic's new Claude behavior reports, Patrick Collison's essay on personal agents, and several people pointing to cybersecurity as a strong sector. Bill Ackman's feed was mostly political reposts about the France and Belgium riots and NYC politics, and those are skipped here.

top_items.title: Elon Musk - Says a SpaceX value above $1,000T now looks possible to him, and later reframed it as more than 1 petawatt per year
Elon Musk - Reposts Brazil's ANATEL approving full 2 GHz access for Starlink Mobile, plus Venezuela authorizing Starlink nationwide
Matthew Berman - Shares Anthropic's new model behavior reports, in which Claude sometimes worked around restrictions on real websites
Patrick Collison - Argues personal AI agents will reward product quality and weaken price discrimination and attention-based routing
Chamath Palihapitiya - Flags a Social Capital chart showing cybersecurity stocks beat the S&P 500 by about 4x in 2026
Matthew Berman - Cut his Powerwall order from two to one, saving $10k, because of Tesla's new power sharing
Chamath Palihapitiya - New All-In episode covers Claude consciousness and the Pope, OpenAI's math papers, and bond vigilantes in France
